message: pnpm 11.2.0 reads only auth and registry settings from .npmrc, so minimum-release-age has no effect
fix: Set minimumReleaseAge in pnpm-workspace.yaml and remove the line from .npmrc

message: pnpm 11.2.0 ignores the "pnpm" field in package.json (onlyBuiltDependencies)
onlyBuiltDependencies was removed in pnpm 11.0.0, so pnpm 11.2.0 builds none of these packages
fix: List the packages under allowBuilds instead
